newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Sri Lanka privatisation body to have monitoring unit.
newsitem.headline: Sri Lanka privatisation body to have monitoring unit.

text.p: Sri Lanka's Public Enterprise Reform Commission (PERC) is to set up a unit to monitor post-privatisation successes, a senior official said on Tuesday.

"PERC is now transaction-driven. But we want to add another dimension and monitor post-privatisation successes, whether agreements are being adhered to, what benefits have accrued to employees, et cetera," said Mano Tittawella, director general of PERC, the state arm that oversees privatisations.
"It is also in line with government policy that it (the government) should be in regulation and not running of business, other than if it involves national security", Tittawella said.
"We are in the process of setting up the unit, which will go on even after PERC's transaction phase has finished," he said.
